dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a book to buy. I'm on a pretty tight budget — I'd like to spend no more than $15. Also, I'm interested in books that offer some advice, you know, something practical or self-improvement oriented. Can you tell me what you have available?
dialogue.agent:
Great news! I found a couple of options within your $15 budget. Here they are:

1. **"Live Like Fiction: 30 Days To Become the Author of Your Own Life Story"** — **$3.21** — ⭐ 4.8 out of 5 stars (7 reviews). A very affordable self-improvement guide to help you take control of your life!

2. **"Think and Grow Rich The Legacy: How the World's Leading Entrepreneurs, Thought Leaders, & Cultural Icons Achieve Success"** — **$14.99** — ⭐ 4.6 out of 5 stars (30 reviews). This one is packed with practical advice and success stories from top entrepreneurs and thought leaders, endorsed by Barbara Corcoran, Bob Proctor, and many others.

Both are great options! Would you like more details or reviews on either of these?

dialogue.user: Both of those sound interesting! The first one is very affordable and seems like it's packed with advice. Can you tell me more about what kind of advice "Live Like Fiction: 30 Days To Become the Author of Your Own Life Story" offers? Like, what are some of the specific topics or examples it covers?
dialogue.agent:
Here's what I found! **"Live Like Fiction: 30 Days To Become the Author of Your Own Life Story"** offers a full month-long blueprint called the **ENGAGE system**, broken down week-by-week:

- **Explore your meaning** (Days 1–5)
- **Narrow your goals** (Days 6–10)
- **Generate a plan** (Days 11–15)
- **Anticipate roadblocks** (Days 16–20)
- **Gain endurance** (Days 21–25)
- **Elevate yourself** (Days 26–30)

It includes 30 illustrated mini-chapters with relatable stories, cutting-edge research, tested tactics, and thought-provoking exercises. The author, Francesco Marconi, is an award-winning media strategist who worked at the Associated Press and Columbia Journalism School, so it draws on storytelling techniques to help you map out your life path.

At **only $3.21** with a stellar **4.8 rating**, it's an absolute steal! Would you like to see some customer reviews for it?

result.title: Live Like Fiction: 30 Days To Become the Author of Your Own Life Story
result.features: When you imagine the next 10 years of your life, what do you see? If you are drawing a blank, breaking into a sweat, or visualizing a finish line but no course to get there, this is the book for you. Live Like Fiction gives you an original and provocative four-week roadmap to authoring your own life story, and a raft of surprising strategies to make it your reality. Each of the 30 illustrated mini-chapters – one for each day of the month - builds on the one before it, offering relatable stories, cutting-edge research, tested tactics and thought-provoking exercises. Through this bootcamp you will learn the ENGAGE system, a six-step process for discovering what drives you and using it to succeed in your career: E xplore you meaning (Day 1-5), N arrow your goals (Day 6-10), G enerate a plan (Day 11-15), A nticipate roadblocks (Day 16-20), G ain endurance (Day 21-25) and E levate yourself (Day 26-30). Award-winning media strategist Francesco Marconi didn’t just write the book on owning your success and creativity – he’s lived it, as a storyteller, speaker and strategist at the Associated Press and fellow at Columbia Journalism School. Now he layers the tricks of his trade on top of fresh scientific research to offer a compelling step by step approach to chart -- and accelerate -- your path to breakthrough personal fulfillment. Blunt, insightful and practical, this is the playbook for the curious and inspired. It’s a blueprint for leveraging storytelling to write your own narrative and find your path. A must for every ambitious graduate, job seeker, new hire – and anyone with a hunger to become the best version of themselves.
